heading: Complex literals (`COMPLEX_LIT`)
text:
### Complex literals (`COMPLEX_LIT`) [LLEX.12.7]

`COMPLEX_LIT` is the surface syntax of the `complex` type ([LUNI.14]). A v1
lexer produces no such token, and `5i` is refused ([LUNI.14.9]).

```
COMPLEX_LIT ::= (INT_LIT | FLOAT_LIT | SCI_LIT) ('i' | 'j')
```
